blockers.detail: nvidia-smi not found, no AMD ROCm, no Intel GPU detected. CPU-only environment.
5.5 GB total RAM, ~4.7 GB available. Insufficient for Qwen3-4B (needs ~8GB even at Q4). Qwen3-1.7B GGUF Q4 might fit but leaves no headroom.
cmake: missing, g++: missing, make: missing. Cannot compile llama-cpp-python or any C++ inference backend from source.
sudo not available. Cannot install system packages (build-essential, cmake, etc.).
curl to huggingface.co failed. Cannot download models from HuggingFace Hub.
ModelScope is reachable but download speed is too slow. A 13 MB file took >2 minutes and arrived corrupted (truncated). A 1.2 GB GGUF model would take hours and likely fail.
No precompiled wheel for llama-cpp-python matching this platform (cp312 manylinux x86_64). Only source tarballs available, which require cmake/g++/make to build.
llama.cpp precompiled binary (13 MB) took >2 minutes to partially download (1.8 MB) and was truncated/corrupted. Network bandwidth too low for reliable downloads.

conclusion: Qwen3-1.7B GGUF cannot be stably downloaded and run in this environment. The 8 local capabilities remain as wiring-only or stub-only. Real model inference requires a GPU-capable environment or at minimum a reliable download path + build toolchain.
recommended_action: Deploy on a GPU-enabled environment (local machine or cloud VM with NVIDIA GPU, ≥16GB RAM, cmake/g++/make available). Alternatively, pre-download GGUF models externally and copy into this workspace.
